verdicts.quote: Failures leave the entire store unchanged.

verdicts.missing: Whether the response lists every failing row or only the first, and whether it states the reason for each failure.

verdicts.quote: A duplicate email (case-insensitive across existing users and within the upload) returns 409 and identifies the conflicting line.
missing or unexpected columns ... return 400. A valid row has exactly two fields, a nonempty trimmed name and a trimmed email

verdicts.quote: POST /users/import with a configured admin bearer token ... Invalid credentials or an unconfigured admin token return 401 without mutation.
verdicts.missing: Whether import permission is distinct from any single-user creation permission is not stated.

verdicts.quote: a UTF-8 text/csv file with one name and one email header, in either order ... Malformed CSV, invalid UTF-8, missing or unexpected columns ... return 400.
Quoted commas, quote escaping and line breaks in names, LF and CRLF, an optional UTF-8 BOM, optional final newline and blank lines are accepted.
Failures leave the entire store unchanged. ... User invitations, individual admin accounts and durable storage are outside the existing product scope.
Requests above 1 MiB return 413, including when no Content-Length is present.
Malformed CSV, invalid UTF-8, missing or unexpected columns, empty imports and invalid rows return 400.
verdicts.missing: Whether a header-only file counts as an empty import, and the behaviour for a single-row file, are not stated explicitly.

verdicts.quote: Imports complete synchronously after body receipt.
User invitations, individual admin accounts and durable storage are outside the existing product scope.
Valid records share the existing process-local lifecycle and read visibility, and reset on process restart.
verdicts.missing: Whether created users are active or pending, have any credential, and how (or whether) they sign in.

verdicts.quote: The caller owns the CSV file; the service holds bytes during the request and never persists the source file.

verdicts.missing: Cancellation of an in-flight import is not addressed; retry of only failed rows is only implied moot by all-or-nothing.
